user.title: DPRemote (Duepi EVO cloud)
user.description: Connect to your stove through Duepi's cloud relay. The device code is the unique code printed on the back of the EVO Remote WiFi module.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the stove through the cloud relay. Check the device code and that the module is online.
error.handshake_pending: The cloud relay handshake is not implemented yet in this build.

abort.already_configured: This device code is already configured.
